candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care — Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement), printed p.22 / PDF p.26: participate in performance improvement projects and quality improvement processes; report identified client-care issues; utilize research/references for performance-improvement actions; evaluate impact of performance-improvement measures on client care and resource use
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — Performance Improvement / use of patient-experience data
candidate.educational_objective: Use patient-experience quality data such as HCAHPS nurse-communication results to participate in evidence-based performance improvement and evaluate the impact on client care.

options.A: Participate in reviewing the communication data, implement an evidence-based improvement strategy, and evaluate whether patient-care results improve
options.B: Ignore the results because patient-experience data are not relevant to quality improvement
options.C: Change the medical record documentation so the survey scores appear more favorable
options.D: Survey only patients expected to give positive ratings before deciding whether improvement is needed

candidate.rationale: CMS describes HCAHPS as a national standardized survey of patients' perspectives of hospital care and includes communication with nurses among the measured domains. NCSBN's 2026 test plan places participation in performance-improvement projects, use of research and other references for improvement actions, and evaluation of the impact of improvement measures within Management of Care. Therefore the nurse should use the identified care issue as quality-improvement data, participate in an evidence-based intervention, and evaluate its effect. A is the best answer.
candidate.source_claim_supported: HCAHPS provides standardized patient-experience data, including communication with nurses, that can identify a care-quality issue for performance-improvement work.
candidate.source_locator: Overview/About the survey: HCAHPS is a national, standardized, publicly reported survey of patients' perspectives of hospital care and captures patient experience of communication with nurses and other hospital-care domains
candidate.source_version_date: Current CMS webpage accessed 2026-08-17; survey content updated beginning 2025
candidate.stem: A hospital's HCAHPS results show a sustained decline in patient ratings of communication with nurses. Which nursing response best reflects performance-improvement practice?
